notes: U.S. operating bank, held by New York Community Bancorp Inc. Per Fork F §4 Decision Q5, canonical name is the operating bank itself (NYCB) since the filings name the operating bank. Counterparty on Jared 2018 (item 5), Jared 2019 (item 3), and Ivanka NE (item 5). Note: NYCB later merged with Flagstar Bank in 2022 (post-disclosure period); the canonical name reflects the entity at the time of disclosure.
